finalCta.paragraph: History: The Peugeot Sport Engineered flagship combines the 200hp 1.6L PureTech turbo petrol with dual electric motors - one integrated into the front e-EAT8 gearbox and a more powerful rear motor for all-wheel drive capability. Total system output is 360hp with 520Nm torque, making it the most powerful production Peugeot ever. The engine code 5GX identifies the PSE-specific calibration.
